what_it_catches: A reconciliation break is open; every payment is held
signal: Reconciliation break events from the outbox, and the policy service's break_active input

what_it_catches: The audit log's hash chain or a head anchor fails verification
signal: forge-audit verify run on a schedule

what_it_catches: WAL archiving has stopped, so point-in-time recovery is shrinking
The last verified offsite copy is old or missing
signal: Receipt file written by scripts/offsite-sync.sh; its age

what_it_catches: Events sit unpublished in an outbox for too long (Kafka down or without quorum)
signal: Age of the oldest unpublished row in each service's outbox table

what_it_catches: Concentration, net outflow, liquidity or suspense alert raised
signal: Treasury-risk alert events (one raised and one cleared per transition)

what_it_catches: A service certificate will expire within 7 days
signal: Certificate expiry from the production certificate authority (cert-manager)

what_it_catches: Many token refusals or MFA refusals in a short time
signal: Counts of refused tokens in service logs (ErrMFARequired included)

what_it_catches: A policy bundle fails signature verification at load
Services cannot export spans, so a trace gap hides activity
signal: OpenTelemetry collector health and exporter errors

what_it_catches: A material incident's 24-hour or 14-day deadline is within 6 hours or has passed
A reachable vulnerability is found in a Go module or npm package
signal: make vulncheck and npm audit in the build, and on a daily schedule
